name: Lost Solace
source:
- God is dead; morality is a lie -

After arriving in the metropolis of Solace City, a man with a shadowed past starts pulling threads that others left tangled. Threads tied to missing girls, a campus with a dark secret, and a city built of corruption and lies.
With no plan but plenty of guts he starts chasing leads and turning stones. But the city doesn't want to be questioned and so he finds himself facing greater challenges than ever before.

Making allies along the way he finds himself tug between his self-bestowed responsibilities and a normal life of peace and happiness. But walking away isn't an option anymore. There's too much on the line and he knows that no one else will step up to the plate.

How will you navigate the perils of Solace City?

[From [url=https://sakurakagedev.itch.io/lost-solace]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
- 上帝死了；道德是一个谎言——

抵达大都市索雷斯城后，一名有着阴影般过去的男子开始解开其他人留下的纠缠不清的线索。与失踪女孩有关的线索，一个隐藏着黑暗秘密的校园，以及一座充满腐败和谎言的城市。
没有计划，但有足够的勇气，他开始追逐线索并转动石头。但这座城市不想受到质疑，因此他发现自己面临着比以往更大的挑战。

在结交盟友的过程中，他发现自己在自己赋予的责任和平静幸福的正常生活之间挣扎。但走开已不再是一种选择。风险太大，他知道没有其他人会挺身而出。

你将如何应对慰藉城的危险？

[来自[url=https://sakurakagedev.itch.io/lost-solace]itch.io[/url]]
